Bluetooth permission is used only to discover, pair with, and communicate with your glasses. You can continue without allowing it now and grant it later when you connect a device.
Pick a starter model. CyanBridge will download it in the background while you finish setup.
Generation settings are selected automatically for the model and GPU acceleration is preferred. You can change or import models later in Local Models.

CyanBridge is an open-source project built by and for the community. You can inspect the code, report issues, suggest ideas, or contribute directly through our GitHub repository.
You can grant this permission later. Until then, CyanBridge will not be able to find, pair with, or connect to your glasses.

CyanBridge uses the microphone when you ask a question, say the wake word or record a meeting, and Apple speech recognition to turn your words into text. You can also allow this later, the first time you ask.
